cases.exposure_context_quote: In May 2023, we admitted four patients from the same family with accidental oral imidacloprid poisoning.
cases.agent_quote: Four patients shared a bottle of imidacloprid (emulsion, 300 g/bottle, 5% active ingredient content)
cases.circumstance: accidental ingestion of a shared bottle of imidacloprid by four family members at noon on May 16, 2023

symptoms.finding: nausea and vomiting (vomit contained food residue and pesticide)
symptoms.quote: The four patients developed nausea and vomiting soon after insecticide intake; the vomit contained food residue and pesticide.

symptoms.finding: varying degrees of disturbed consciousness (lethargy to light coma)
symptoms.quote: Soon after, they developed varying degrees of disturbances in consciousness, such as lethargy and light coma.
In addition, all four patients had elevated blood pressure levels.

labs.name: white blood cell count
labs.quote: Laboratory tests revealed an elevated white blood cell count, neutrophil ratio, and the levels of some inflammatory factors.

labs.name: troponin I / cholinesterase / coagulation markers
labs.quote: None of the patients had abnormalities in troponin I, cholinesterase, or coagulation marker levels.

labs.name: initial blood imidacloprid concentration
labs.quote: The initial concentration of imidacloprid was 3.423 μg/mL, 4.935 μg/mL, 2.624 μg/mL, and 0.013 μg/mL (reference value < 0.001 μg/mL).

labs.name: transaminases
labs.quote: Three patients had mild elevations in transaminase levels (case 1, 2, and 4)

labs.name: urea nitrogen
labs.quote: three patients had transient mild elevations in urea nitrogen (case 1, 2, and 3)

treatment.name: gastric lavage
treatment.quote: Approximately 30 min later, they were transported to the poisoning department of our hospital by ambulance and immediately treated with gastric lavage.

treatment.name: dexamethasone
treatment.quote: Commonly used therapeutic drugs are dexamethasone (10 mg/day, intravenous drip)

treatment.name: furosemide
treatment.quote: furosemide (20 mg, twice per day, intravenous injection)

treatment.name: nalmefene
treatment.quote: nalmefene (0.1 mg, twice per day, intravenous injection)

treatment.name: total gastrointestinal decontamination (montmorillonite powder and activated charcoal in 20% mannitol)
treatment.quote: Total gastrointestinal decontamination was performed after gastric lavage. The specific method was as follows: montmorillonite powder (30 g) was dissolved in 250 mL of 20% mannitol and administered in divided doses; activated charcoal (powder) (30 g) was dissolved in 20% mannitol (250 mL) and administered in divided doses.

treatment.name: HA330 hemoperfusion
treatment.quote: HA330 hemoperfusion was simultaneously administered; on the first day, hemoperfusion was performed twice at an interval of 4 h, and once a day on days two and three.

cases.outcome_quote: Patients one and four were discharged after 10 days of treatment, while patients two and three were cured and discharged after 14 days.
